title: SGNE-CC v2 column-constrained weight edit ported to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
summary: The SGNE-CC (Spherical Gated Norm-preserving Edit, Column-Constrained) weight editing technique was applied to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B by rotating 205 down-projection columns in the MLP layers. The 603 KB training-free patch preserves Euclidean column norms while reducing repetitive self-verification loops and reasoning trace length under deterministic greedy decoding.
research_notes:
Obtain the base DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B model weights in safetensors format.

Apply the 603 KB column-rotation patch directly to the 205 designated mlp.down_proj weight columns without altering model architecture or inference code.

Run model evaluation with greedy decoding (temperature=0, presence_penalty=0) to generate concise reasoning traces without token-limit loops.

Evaluate models under deterministic greedy decoding (temperature=0, presence_penalty=0) rather than relying on sampling penalties, as SGNE-CC is specifically optimized to stabilize greedy reasoning paths.

Verify that Euclidean column norms in mlp.down_proj remain preserved within 0.16% variance following BF16 rounding to ensure numerical stability and prevent internal representation degradation.
